title: Gulshan i Raz, the Mystic Rose Garden
author: Mahmud Shabistari (Whinfield trans)
description: Whinfield's translation of Shabistari's Mystic Rose Garden presents a poetic guide to Sufi metaphysics. It explores the relationship between unity and multiplicity, spiritual knowledge and the symbolic language of love.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. Source text obtained from the Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/gulshanirazmysti00shabuoft).
rights: From the curator's private collection. Publication rights for this edition are to be confirmed before public release.
